title: Atlas: owner-surveyed Holovator photo map (21 approximate research entries)
consolidation_note: 21-entry90-photo standalone Holovator fieldbook superseded by #77 and later111-photo releases. Keep catalogue policy/source provenance; do not overwrite current Explorer, plan or photo counts.
original_pr_description:
## Goal
Preserve the owner's 22 November firsthand Pokémon Legends: Z-A Holovator survey and make a usable, zoomable read-only map on the **independent GitHub edition**, without modifying the original ChatGPT-hosted Site.

## Already merged / evidence
- PR #75 merged 85 verified genuine binary JPG photo assets to main, in addition to five Jaune 11 JPGs already present: 90 hosted original photographs, not 90 devices.
- The same 85-file import was verified by SHA1/size before merge.
- Owner survey photos distinguish **permanent gold triple-chevron Holovators** from day-changing DLC Hyperspace portals.

## Changes in this draft PR
- Structured 21-entry owner-survey catalog: `MAPS_OWNER_HOLOVATOR_21_SURVEY_CATALOG_2026-11-22.json`, with location clues, approach directions, research-only 1920px city image points and exact GitHub JPG asset paths.
- Add `holovator-map.html` / `.js` / `.css`: original 1920x1920 Lumiose City map, photo-backed lift pins, district/landmark search, zoom/pan, original photographs where **actually hosted**, and prominent inexact-position warnings.
- Add a single link to this dedicated page from `maps.html` and `sector-maps.html`, without changing their 20 Wild Zone positions, 48 sectors or numbered item/screw data.
- Add a regression test and checkpoint the mapping master plan + `MAPS_UPGRADE_MANIFEST.json` revision 22.

## Evidence limits / blockers
- All 21 map dots are **approximate**; none is an authoritative exact pixel or roof X/Y. The external list of 23 Holovators has **not** been fully identity-matched.
- 11 recent original photos (WZ6: 5; Café Cyclone courtyard: 6) are only in the locally verified binary-transfer ZIP, **not yet in GitHub**. The viewer does not use broken image paths for these.
- Ten older photos for #61 Bleu3 and Vert4 south are documented in survey JSON but are also not yet GitHub-hosted.
- The Rouge5 return visit is a repeat of the same physical lift and is not counted as a second location.
- This draft awaits tests and visual QA before being considered for merge; additional source-to-map registration required for precise permanent pins.

## Safeguards
**No** changes to the original ChatGPT Site, Supabase, player ratings/feedback/saved progress, original city JPG, core walkthrough/game logic, or DLC dynamic icons. No use of Repo Desk, CG Repair Lab, Code God, or Writer. This PR is not a deployment or authorization to overwrite the live guide.

## Next chunk
Check the new fieldbook test plus existing static/map regression suite; reconcile any geometry ambiguities; attach 11+10 photo binaries using a verified binary route; only then consider ready-for-review/merge with green checks.

## Final owner-survey archive and climbing-policy update (22 Nov 2026)
- **Owner field survey closed for lifts found and unlocked**; this is not the same as independently verifying all reported 23 device IDs. No duplicate for the Rouge 5 return visit.
- **Ladders/scaffolding:** the owner's game map does not show every climb as a map marker. A dedicated visible fieldbook section and `docs/HOLOVATOR_SURVEY_AND_CLIMB_NAVIGATION_POLICY_2026-11-22.md` explain walking/roof routes, but do **not** invent exact ladder/scaffold pins.
- **Two integrity-checked local handoff archives:** `lumiose-atlas-holovator-github-ready-complete-2026-11-22.zip` (96 JPGs; SHA256 `83a4731f32f9b7e04c5a42a2e5ee56bbdecee6b127a554a46dde253ebc040c85`), and `lumiose-atlas-holovator-github-import-missing-11-2026-11-22.zip` (11 JPGs; SHA256 `48431ce208a6b6f5a955e1dfb5c52dc114ee09d4464da4746aba3799f91b827b`). The older combined provenance archive has 218 entries. **These archives are ChatGPT handoff attachments, not committed GitHub binaries.**
- The previously imported 90 photo JPGs remain unchanged. The last 11 photo binaries are still **pending direct GitHub upload**, as are 10 earlier owner-source photos. Missing photos must not be linked as if hosted.
- Updated `MAPS_SECTOR_UPGRADE_MASTER_PLAN.md` and `MAPS_UPGRADE_MANIFEST.json` (revision 23), plus a regression assertion for the visible no-invented-pins policy.
- **Do not merge/publish** until these checks are green, real image assets are present, fieldbook counts reflect the actual host state and manual mobile/desktop map QA is done. Original ChatGPT Site, Supabase, feedback, ratings and player progress remain untouched.
